verdict.rationale: The docs describe official SDKs for Python and TypeScript (plus Go, Java, and C#) on one API key and one SDK, covering Parse, Extract, Classify, Split, and Index (docs-43, docs-20, docs-44). The GitHub migration notice names the Python (`llama-cloud`) and TypeScript (`@llamaindex/llama-cloud`) packages, and the docs show a `client.parsing.parse` example plus TypeScript/Node.js examples. The Extract page lists only a Python SDK and REST API, which leaves TypeScript Extract coverage ambiguous. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the SDKs are typed, documented SDK-level job management (status/listing/polling), evidence of sensible defaults (the example sets tier and version explicitly), confirmed TypeScript coverage of Extract, and independent hands-on corroboration.
